summary: Park Ha Biological Technology Co., Ltd., a foreign private issuer, filed Form 6-K disclosing a change in its independent registered public accounting firm. On September 1, 2026, the Audit Committee and Board terminated WWC, P.C. as auditor and ratified the appointment of HTL INTERNATIONAL, LLC as the new independent auditor. WWC's reports for fiscal years 2024 and 2025 contained no adverse opinion or qualification. There were no disagreements or reportable events with WWC. WWC's letter is attached as Exhibit 16.1. This is a routine auditor-change disclosure under Form 20-F Item 16F, not a special situation.
